title: Glory to God in the Highest

request.style: English, sacred choral anthem, full mixed choir with soprano descant, pipe organ, strings, brass fanfare, bells, radiant and jubilant, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host
Appeared with the angel
Praising God and saying

[Chorus]
Glory to God in the highest
And on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests
Glory to God in the highest
And on earth peace

[Verse]
A great company of the heavenly host
Praising God and saying

[Chorus]
Glory to God in the highest
And on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests
Glory to God in the highest
And on earth peace

[Bridge]
Glory to God
Glory to God in the highest
Glory to God
Glory to God in the highest

[Outro]
And on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests
Glory to God in the highest
